question: Among the following, name the software components of a computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Programs** are considered software components of a computer.
 
• Software components include applications, operating systems, and utilities that help the computer perform tasks.
 
• These components are essential for the computer to execute various functions and operations as per user commands.
 
• Unlike hardware components, software components are intangible and stored digitally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hardware components** include physical parts of a computer such as the CPU, memory, and CMOS.
 
• Software and hardware work together to make the computer functional.
 
• The distinction between software and hardware is crucial for understanding computer architecture and operation.
 
• Software can be categorized into system software, application software, and middleware.
